reviews.title: Doesn’t work on my phone can’t get a refund
reviews.text:
I tried getting a free trial on this app, unknowingly my girlfriend had tried the same app on my phone months earlier. You only get the free trial when you sign up for a full year but it doesn’t visually indicate in the app that you are ineligible for it. On the second screen it showed I would be charged - I assumed after 3 days but also assumed I could get a refund after that so now I am out 60$ for an app I can’t even use. 

It doesn’t work with my phone’s case and camera, which is when I would need to use while I’m on a run. I would very comfortably have paid to try it for a month or understood it had to be prorated after the trial but apple support denied me for putting in the wrong reason as a header despite my description.

Is there anything you can do to fix this? I would like to use this app when I upgrade my phone and recommend it to my friends but now in my mind it’s just the app that stole 60$ from me.

reviews.title: No longer works. Nonexistent customer service.
reviews.text: Not only does the app no longer work properly. Forget it if you have a newer model phone. It is finicky at best if your finger tip is not borderline hot and pressed against the camera so hard you feel like you’re punching a hole through the back of your phone.   There is absolutely no customer support. Aside from them, seemingly responding to negative reviews in the App Store. And granted this is on me, but the fact that I have been paying for this on a monthly basis at $10 a month for four years when clearly I meant to choose the $60 annual price just sucks. I reached out to no avail to see if they can possibly find it in their heart, pun intended, to possibly reimburse me for paying so much extra for so long, but of course, no response. I’m sure this one star review will get some attention. Aside from the subscription issue, which I have to take fault on (was just hoping for some basic decent business practice) the App Store deserves the one star rating for the other reasons listed above.
